title: Fuzzy RDD: imperfect compliance with admission cutoff

llm_response.content:
## 1. Identification Strategy
- Method: Fuzzy Regression Discontinuity Design (fuzzy RDD) using the cutoff crossing (z = 1[running_var ≥ 0.5]) as an instrument for actual scholarship receipt (treated). We estimate the Local Average Treatment Effect (LATE) of scholarship receipt on graduation around the GPA cutoff using a local linear 2SLS on observations near the cutoff.
- Why: Eligibility jumps discretely at the cutoff but take-up is imperfect (exceptions and decliners). A fuzzy RDD leverages the first-stage discontinuity in treatment probability at the cutoff to identify the causal effect for compliers.
- Key assumptions:
  - Continuity: Potential outcomes (graduation, absent scholarship status) vary smoothly in GPA at the cutoff.
  - First stage: There is a nonzero discontinuity in scholarship receipt at the cutoff (relevance).
  - Exclusion: Near the cutoff, eligibility affects graduation only through scholarship receipt.
  - Monotonicity: No defiers (crossing the cutoff weakly increases the chance of receiving the scholarship for everyone near the cutoff).

## 2. R Code
```r
# Load packages
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(AER)
  library(sandwich)
  library(lmtest)
  library(dplyr)
  library(readr)
})

# 1) Read data
df <- read_csv("experiments/exp_b/data/s30_data.csv",
               show_col_types = FALSE)

# 2) Construct RDD variables
cutoff <- 0.5
df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    z = as.integer(running_var >= cutoff),        # eligibility instrument
    x = running_var - cutoff,                      # centered running variable
    x_pos = ifelse(x > 0, x, 0),                   # allow different slopes across cutoff
    x2 = x^2,
    x2_pos = ifelse(x > 0, x^2, 0)
  )

# Main estimation window: use supplied near_cutoff indicator
dat_main <- df %>% filter(near_cutoff == 1)

cat("Sample size (near cutoff):", nrow(dat_main), "\n")

# Check first-stage discontinuity (simple difference in means)
jump_treat <- with(dat_main, mean(treated[z==1]) - mean(treated[z==0]))
cat("First-stage jump in treatment at cutoff (mean treated | z=1 - z=0):",
    round(jump_treat, 4), "\n")

# 3) First-stage regression (treated on z with local linear controls)
fs <- lm(treated ~ z + x + x_pos, data = dat_main)
fs_rob <- coeftest(fs, vcov = vcovHC(fs, type = "HC1"))
fs_coef <- fs_rob["z", "Estimate"]
fs_se   <- fs_rob["z", "Std. Error"]
fs_t    <- fs_rob["z", "t value"]
fs_p    <- fs_rob["z", "Pr(>|t|)"]

cat("\nFirst stage (treated ~ z + x + x_pos):\n",
    "  Coef on z:", round(fs_coef, 4),
    "  SE:", round(fs_se, 4),
    "  t:", round(fs_t, 2),
    "  p:", signif(fs_p, 3), "\n")

# 4) Main fuzzy RDD via 2SLS (local linear, fully interacted slopes via x and x_pos)
iv_main <- ivreg(
  y ~ treated + x + x_pos | x + x_pos + z,
  data = dat_main
)
iv_main_rob <- coeftest(iv_main, vcov = vcovHC(iv_main, type = "HC1"))
tau_hat <- iv_main_rob["treated", "Estimate"]
tau_se  <- iv_main_rob["treated", "Std. Error"]
tau_p   <- iv_main_rob["treated", "Pr(>|t|)"]
ci_low  <- tau_hat - 1.96 * tau_se
ci_high <- tau_hat + 1.96 * tau_se

cat("\nMain fuzzy RDD 2SLS (local linear):\n",
    "  LATE of scholarship on graduation (coef on treated):", round(tau_hat, 4), "\n",
    "  Robust SE:", round(tau_se, 4), "  95% CI: [", round(ci_low, 4), ",", round(ci_high, 4), "]",
    "  p-value:", signif(tau_p, 3), "\n")

# 5) Robustness checks

# 5a) Higher-order polynomial (quadratic) in running var with side-specific curvature
iv_quad <- ivreg(
  y ~ treated + x + x_pos + x2 + x2_pos | x + x_pos + x2 + x2_pos + z,
  data = dat_main
)
iv_quad_rob <- coeftest(iv_quad, vcov = vcovHC(iv_quad, type = "HC1"))
tau_hat_q <- iv_quad_rob["treated", "Estimate"]
tau_se_q  <- iv_quad_rob["treated", "Std. Error"]
ci_low_q  <- tau_hat_q - 1.96 * tau_se_q
ci_high_q <- tau_hat_q + 1.96 * tau_se_q

cat("\nRobustness: Quadratic controls (x, x_pos, x^2, x_pos^2):\n",
    "  LATE:", round(tau_hat_q, 4),
    "  SE:", round(tau_se_q, 4),
    "  95% CI: [", round(ci_low_q, 4), ",", round(ci_high_q, 4), "]\n")

# 5b) Narrower symmetric bandwidth around cutoff (|x| <= h)
h <- 0.10
dat_bw <- df %>% filter(abs(x) <= h)
cat("Sample size (|x| <=", h, "):", nrow(dat_bw), "\n")
iv_bw <- ivreg(
  y ~ treated + x + x_pos | x + x_pos + z,
  data = dat_bw
)
iv_bw_rob <- coeftest(iv_bw, vcov = vcovHC(iv_bw, type = "HC1"))
tau_hat_bw <- iv_bw_rob["treated", "Estimate"]
tau_se_bw  <- iv_bw_rob["treated", "Std. Error"]
ci_low_bw  <- tau_hat_bw - 1.96 * tau_se_bw
ci_high_bw <- tau_hat_bw + 1.96 * tau_se_bw

cat("\nRobustness: Narrower bandwidth (|x| <=", h, "):\n",
    "  LATE:", round(tau_hat_bw, 4),
    "  SE:", round(tau_se_bw, 4),
    "  95% CI: [", round(ci_low_bw, 4), ",", round(ci_high_bw, 4), "]\n")

# 5c) Placebo cutoffs: 0.45 and 0.55
run_placebo <- function(cut, h = 0.10) {
  dat <- df %>%
    mutate(
      z_p = as.integer(running_var >= cut),
      x_p = running_var - cut,
      x_p_pos = ifelse(x_p > 0, x_p, 0)
    ) %>%
    filter(abs(x_p) <= h)
  if (nrow(dat) < 30) return(c(NA, NA, NA, NA, nrow(dat)))
  iv_p <- ivreg(
    y ~ treated + x_p + x_p_pos | x_p + x_p_pos + z_p,
    data = dat
  )
  rob <- coeftest(iv_p, vcov = vcovHC(iv_p, type = "HC1"))
  est <- rob["treated", "Estimate"]
  se  <- rob["treated", "Std. Error"]
  c(est, se, est - 1.96 * se, est + 1.96 * se, nrow(dat))
}

place_045 <- run_placebo(0.45, h = 0.10)
place_055 <- run_placebo(0.55, h = 0.10)

cat("\nPlacebo cutoff at 0.45 (|x| <= 0.10):\n",
    "  N:", place_045[5],
    "  LATE:", round(place_045[1], 4),
    "  SE:", round(place_045[2], 4),
    "  95% CI: [", round(place_045[3], 4), ",", round(place_045[4], 4), "]\n")

cat("Placebo cutoff at 0.55 (|x| <= 0.10):\n",
    "  N:", place_055[5],
    "  LATE:", round(place_055[1], 4),
    "  SE:", round(place_055[2], 4),
    "  95% CI: [", round(place_055[3], 4), ",", round(place_055[4], 4), "]\n")
```

## 3. Expected Findings
- Sign: Positive. Receiving a scholarship should increase on-time graduation for marginal students around the GPA cutoff.
- Magnitude: A local average treatment effect of roughly 0.10–0.20 (10–20 percentage points) on four-year graduation is plausible for compliers at the threshold, given financial frictions and persistence effects. Robustness checks should yield similar positive estimates and a strong first stage (clear jump in scholarship receipt at the cutoff).

_ground_truth.identification_strategy: Fuzzy RDD — eligibility cutoff as IV for scholarship receipt; LATE = ITT / first-stage jump
_ground_truth.conclusion_detail: Scholarship receipt significantly improves graduation rates for compliers
_ground_truth.main_effect: ~25pp graduation rate increase (LATE via fuzzy RDD)
